package.name: sim_mjlidar_bridge
package.description: Mirror-state MuJoCo-LiDAR sidecar (§11.2): subscribes /sim/mj_state, mirrors the compiled simulation model (poses only, mj_kinematics), raycasts the Livox Mid360 rosette on the CPU backend at 10 Hz and publishes /livox/lidar, ground-truth /odom and TF odom->base_link. Runs on system Python 3.10 + rclpy (R-11).
